title: BB defending vs a middle raise
keyIdea: Middle-position opens are wider, so defend wider: more suited kings and queens, more connectors, and more offsuit broadways.

actions.call: JJ-22, AQs-A6s, A4s-A2s, K8s+, Q8s+, J8s+, T8s+, 97s+, 86s+, 75s+, 64s+, 54s, AQo-ATo, KJo+, QJo

notes.A5s: A classic bluff raise: the ace blocks AA/AK, and it can still make a straight or the nut flush.
